method: custom donor-balanced disjoint KNN metacells followed by WGCNA;not hdWGCNA implementation
normalization: sum raw metacell counts,all-gene library normalize10000,log1p
gene_filter: unique symbol,nonmitochondrial,detected>=5% balanced candidate cells and >=3 donors;top6000 log-normalized variance;no forced LYPLA1
pca: top2000 variable eligible Wu genes;50 PCs;study-specific PCA;within-donor neighbors
biological_unit: author donor labels,not independently genotype verified
inference: metacells not independent patient replicates;no cell-level P
soft_power_rule: smallest candidate with signed scale-free R2>=.8 and negative slope and mean connectivity>=5;else largest fit among mean connectivity>=5;fallback labelled
stability: leave-one-donor-out fixed-module LYPLA1 kME,not full network reclustering stability
enrichment: GO BP hypergeometric all modules;BH across all tested module-term pairs;network gene universe
external_gene_handling: Wu network retains all eligible genes; Pal uses uniquely matching symbols only; missing symbols listed without alias guessing

external_preservation.purpose: exploratory preservation of metacell-discovered modules across donor-level expression
